interpretations.decision: --previous refresh records supersedes {overlay_id, vector_digest, links_invalidated, invalidated_link_ids sorted, capped at the constant 10000 with a truncation flag}; equal fresh output gives supersedes null and byte identity (fixpoint); impact refuses an overlay whose consumer snapshot is no longer active (stale_revision_vector)

The overlay records a canonical mapping digest (role-ordered, key-order and whitespace independent); variants: swapped repositories, reordered keys and environment, moved input files, permuted CLI options, PYTHONHASHSEED, fresh graph roots at the same repo paths (subject to Day-1 (e)), --previous fixpoint

Roots come only from role-keyed CLI options; a mapping or overlay naming any other repository id is rejected repository_not_allowlisted before any CodeGraph is constructed; proven with constructor and lease call counting and an indexed sentinel third repository

No graph write path is reachable (read-only leases, mode=ro); SHA-256, size, mode and mtime inventories of both repositories, both graph roots, the sentinel and the inputs are equal before and after every command, including every rejection path; only --output is written
